title: 8 CFR – Aliens and Nationality (Quy định Di trú)
typeLabel: Quy định / Văn bản dưới luật

versions.text:
8 CFR – Aliens and Nationality.
Part 204: Immigrant petitions.
Part 207-209: Refugees and asylees.
Part 214: Nonimmigrant classes (H-1B, L-1, F-1, J-1, O-1, etc.).
Part 245: Adjustment of status.
Part 274a: Control of employment of aliens (I-9 requirements).
